experiment.headline: Developer reports spending substantial time configuring an Express + TypeScript project and asks for Vite-like boilerpla
experiment.body: Built for a recurring problem observed in public developer discussions: Developer reports spending substantial time configuring an Express + TypeScript project and asks for Vite-like boilerplate/scaffolding. / Developer reports repeatedly spending the first day of new Node API projects wiring the same Express and TypeScript setup before business logic. / Developer identifies a gap between bloated commercial templates and under-tested quick starters and proposes a modular Node/Express starter emphasizing tests, deployment pipelines and documentation.. Reusable Express + TypeScript starter with strict TypeScript, JSON middleware, a health route, environment example, and dev/build/start scripts.
